title: What Can $11 Million Buy? — dramatized dollar figures
description: X/Twitter card. The full opposition figure $11,077,173 set enormous in red over a small green $323,426, labeled “spent opposing him” / “spent supporting him,” with “a 34 : 1 gap.”
alt_text: Graphic titled “What Can $11 Million Buy?” A huge red figure $11,077,173 labeled “spent opposing him” towers over a small green $323,426 labeled “spent supporting him” — noted as a 34 to 1 gap. Footer says every FEC filing is linked.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
